candidates.explanation: Clear board-owned orchestration and policy, board-language dependency roles, private adapters over narrow public server surfaces, an acyclic capability graph, a route consuming only board/rsc.ts, layered authorization, and exactly-once unexpected-failure reporting. No negative criterion is violated.

Clearly assigns cross-capability policy to board, uses board-owned ports and private adapters calling work-items/server.ts and labels/server.ts, preserves capability independence and acyclicity, exposes board/rsc.ts to the RSC route, and specifies layered authorization with one reporting owner. Minor wording inconsistencies about whether authentication/reporting sit in page.tsx or rsc.ts do not undermine the required behavior or create duplicated board orchestration.
